verdict.rationale: E2B's own GitHub repository describes it as open-source infrastructure, so its source is publicly readable. The repo also points to a self-hosting guide for deploying the infrastructure with Terraform, which indicates the infrastructure code is published too. missing for 10: the specific license name (e.g., Apache-2.0/MIT) is not stated in the evidence, it is unclear which components (SDKs vs. infrastructure) are covered, and there is no independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
Read the self-hosting guide to learn how to set up the E2B infrastructure on your own. The infrastructure is deployed using Terraform.
